background_image_description: Full-bleed decorative backdrop: a subtle square grid of thin lines (~80 px spacing) in a slightly darker periwinkle-blue (#6f7fe0) over the base color. Scattered crisp white (#ffffff) starbursts with 6–8 points appear behind the headline: one large at top-right (~x1350,y190), medium at left-mid (~x280,y460), small at far-left (~x140,y720), and another small at right-mid (~x1230,y940). A thin white horizontal rule runs nearly full width near the bottom (~y1270) with two vertical white divider lines rising from it around the lower third of the canvas (approximately at x540 and x1085).

nodes.asset_description: Stylized three-line headline reading “DON’T MISS OUT” set in a chunky retro display style: uppercase hot pink letters (#f43aa6) with a thick golden-yellow outline (#ffc400) and a pronounced offset drop shadow down-right in deep royal blue (#1f4db4). The words are stacked (DON’T on top, MISS in the middle, OUT at the bottom), tightly kerned with rounded corners and an angled apostrophe. The shadow is consistently offset ~24 px down and right, creating a layered, cutout effect.
